title: Potion HP Update
summary: Oxblood, a +12 HP ally potion, and Thin Blood, a -9 HP enemy potion, were added. HP-changing potion tooltips and bottle art were also updated.
impact: The Gear list now includes both confirmed HP potions. The official note does not publish a price or slot requirement, so those fields remain intentionally blank here.

title: Leader Art Updates
summary: Bow and Lord's Bow no longer use shield-rig flipping, and Zealous received dedicated shop and action poses for melee and bow styles.
impact: This changes presentation only. No leader stat, trait, or equipment value was published in this note.

title: Shop Stills & Combat Art
summary: Shop and inspect previews can now use a dedicated still pose separate from combat. The training final Horror was reduced from 40 HP to 25 HP.
impact: Screens and cards may use a different non-combat pose than battle art. The only confirmed gameplay number in this note is the final training Horror's 25 HP.

title: Combat SFX Preload
summary: Combat sounds now preload for live and multiplayer fights, reducing delayed or missing first-hit, death, and movement cues on slower connections.
impact: No unit, gear, or board-rule value changed in this patch.

title: Character Art Cleanup
summary: Giant Peasant pose definitions were cleaned up so more states fall back to its intended default idle hold; internal hit-sink logic and content data were also cleaned up.
impact: No public unit-stat or item-value change is documented in this patch. Strategy pages remain on their prior value baseline, while presentation references can use the current art state.

title: New Art, Motion & Flinging
summary: Combat, shop, and inspect scenes gained richer carry poses, attack recovery, clearer damage floaters, and new death art; Flinging now grants +1 RNG, applies -35% SPD, and still stuns on hit for one second.
impact: Any Flinging equipment or build note must use the new range and speed tradeoff. The remaining documented changes are presentation and content-catalog updates rather than broad balance claims.

title: Leader Kits & Outcast Updated
summary: Leader kit displays now use 0 for the stat dumped by esoteric traits, featured loadouts reflect hire requirements, and Outcast no longer grants bonus armor to isolated allies.
impact: Recheck leader-card comparisons and any plan that assumed Outcast granted armor to isolated allies; the leader itself retains the armor benefit.

title: New Bone Host Leaders
summary: Bone Host child and dog leader traits were revised, two named leaders changed, and Feast received a base-unit fix.
impact: Bone Host leader planning should be rechecked before carrying an older trait assumption into a run.

title: Rod Art Adjusted
summary: The Rod of Many Tales artwork dimensions were corrected for in-game display.

title: Gear Art & Evaluation Updates
summary: Hammer and Rod art changed; Bian of the Eagle support values and Rod evaluation behavior were updated.
impact: Shop and AI evaluations should better recognize spell-focused Rod pairings.

title: New Gear & Combat Tempo
summary: Rod of Many Tales and Bian of the Eagle were added alongside staff changes and stun-movement timing fixes.
impact: INT builds gained new gear choices while movement after stuns became more consistent.

title: Combat & UI Polish
summary: Frostfall, Ward, several units, charms, and combat presentation received balance or clarity changes.
impact: Older Frostfall timing and several unit baselines should not be treated as current.
